tieDefinition.definition: Two candidates have identical FinalScore after all scoring and penalty steps
tieDefinition.detection: sortCandidatesByScore uses stable sorting - equal scores maintain input order

stableFallback: Candidate ID canonical identity (not used as tie-breaker; stable sort is sufficient)

implementation.sortMethod: sort.SliceStable in ScoreBehaviorCandidates; bubble sort in sortCandidatesByScore
implementation.stability: Stable - equal elements maintain relative order
